questions.question: Mina, now a national implantology reference, is invited to an international congress. What message should she carry?
options: Implantology is a model of surgical excellence
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Implantology is a model of surgical excellence.' 🦅 Sami: 'I am proud of you.'

questions.question: Sami must create a foundation to promote implantology. What is the main objective?
questions.explanation: 🦅 Sami explains: 'Promoting excellence in implantology is essential for the future.' 🐆 Mina: 'I will support this foundation.'

questions.question: Mina must write a reference book on implantology. What is the central message?
options: Implantology is an art that combines surgery, planning, and prosthesis
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Implantology is an art that combines surgery, planning, and prosthesis.' 🦅 Sami: 'I completely agree.'

questions.question: Sami must give a closing speech at an international congress. What note should he leave?
options: Implantology is evolving, full of opportunities
questions.explanation: 🦅 Sami explains: 'Implantology is evolving, full of opportunities.' 🐆 Mina: 'I agree.'

questions.question: Mina must create a mentoring program in implantology. What is the main objective?
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Mentoring transmits fundamental implantology skills.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will support this program.'

questions.question: Sami must manage the succession of his implantology expertise. What is the best strategy?
options: Gradually prepare the transmission of skills
questions.explanation: 🦅 Sami explains: 'Gradual preparation of transmission is the key to a successful succession.' 🐆 Mina: 'I will help you.'

questions.question: Mina must create an implantology charter. What is the fundamental pillar?
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Planning and surgical rigor are the pillars of any implantology charter.' 🦅 Sami: 'I completely agree.'

questions.question: Sami must train future implantology mentors. What is the first message to convey?
options: Mentoring is a mission of support and transmission
Mentoring is a source of income
questions.explanation: 🦅 Sami explains: 'Mentoring is a mission of support and transmission.' 🐆 Mina: 'I will convey this message.'

questions.question: Mina must prepare a testimony on her implantology journey. What is the most striking element?
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'The satisfaction of rebuilding smiles is the most striking element.' 🦅 Sami: 'I agree.'

questions.question: Sami must create an alumni association in implantology. What is the main objective?
options: Maintain the link and foster mutual support
questions.explanation: 🦅 Sami explains: 'Mutual support and the link are the driving forces of an alumni association.' 🐆 Mina: 'I will support this association.'

questions.question: Mina must write an article on the future of implantology. What trend should be highlighted?
options: Digital innovation in service of precision
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Digital innovation in service of precision is a promising trend.' 🦅 Sami: 'I completely agree.'

questions.question: Sami must create a quality label for implantology. What are the main criteria?
questions.explanation: 🦅 Sami explains: 'The quality of planning and results are the fundamental criteria.' 🐆 Mina: 'I agree.'

questions.question: Mina must give a farewell speech to the profession. What message should she leave?
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'The profession needs implantology enthusiasts.' 🦅 Sami: 'I completely agree.'

questions.question: Sami must create an award for young dentists in implantology. What is the purpose?
questions.explanation: 🦅 Sami explains: 'Excellence in implantology is the driving force of the profession's evolution.' 🐆 Mina: 'I will support this award.'

questions.question: Mina must write her memoirs. What is the common thread to highlight?
options: The passion for implantology and patient service
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'The passion for implantology is the common thread of a professional life.' 🦅 Sami: 'I agree.'

questions.question: Sami must create an implantology training center. What is the vision?
questions.explanation: 🦅 Sami explains: 'Training must produce implantology professionals.' 🐆 Mina: 'I agree.'

questions.question: Mina must leave a legacy to the profession. What is the most beautiful legacy?
options: Implantology skills and an example to follow
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Implantology skills and the example are the most beautiful legacy.' 🦅 Sami: 'I completely agree.'

questions.question: Sami must write a letter to future dentists about implantology. What message should it convey?
options: Implantology is an exciting and promising discipline
questions.explanation: 🦅 Sami explains: 'Implantology is an exciting and promising discipline.' 🐆 Mina: 'I completely agree.'

questions.question: Mina must create a scholarship for implantology students. What is the main objective?
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Supporting deserving students is an investment for the future.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will support this initiative.'

options: Implantology continues to evolve with those who carry it

options: Sell her knowledge at the highest price
Transmit in the continuity of skills

questions.question: Sami must create a peer network for young dentists in implantology. What is the objective?
options: Foster mutual support and experience sharing

options: Implantology is a magnificent human adventure

options: Implantology is a discipline worth experiencing

questions.question: Mina, after a life dedicated to implantology, receives national recognition. Sami is by her side. What is Mina's message to young dentists?
